description: This file implements a custom guardrail for PII masking using Microsoft Presidio within a larger language model or chat system. It handles PII analysis and anonymization by interacting with external Presidio APIs, manages configuration, performs masking, and integrates with logging and streaming response pipelines. The class `_OPTIONAL_PresidioPIIMasking` extends `CustomGuardrail` and includes methods for PII analysis, anonymization, threshold filtering, and streaming unmasking of PII in model responses.
